consequences: No behaviour removed. `pnpm knip` is clean. Both surfaces resolve links the same way, covered by a CLI test.
context: Review WP10 ran knip (ADR 0005) and compared MCP with the CLI. The CLI stored short-handle note links as written while MCP resolved them to full ids.
decision: Remove `export` from 8 symbols knip found used only in their own file (inRepo, hookWaiting, TXN_IDLE_MS, InitResult, UpgradeResult, Lock, Activity, Drift). Remove recordLinks and LINKABLE from packages/mcp/src/server.ts; the same logic now lives in core as resolveLinks, used by MCP and the CLI note command.
title: WP10: unexport single-file symbols, move MCP link resolving to core
